psychological_meaning: Moss Green evokes feelings of nature, growth, and stability. It is associated with tranquility, peace, and harmony, reflecting the quiet strength and resilience found in the natural world. Moss green can also symbolize wealth, health, and renewal, creating a sense of balance and well-being.
